name: v0.14.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Add complex Pauli LCU block encoding by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/598
* Fix SELECT serialization operand pairing by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/606
* Reject vector controls in inverse blocks by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/605
* Rollback output from declined callable emitters by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/607
* Require code examples in branch summaries by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/609
* Bump the uv group across 1 directory with 9 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/604
* Bump torch from 2.11.0 to 2.13.0 in the uv group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/610
* Optimize docs-only CI by @yuyamashiro in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/585
* Add periodic shift LCU block encoding by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/608
* Add executable FTQC Shor resource estimation by @yuyamashiro in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/613
* Add structural math intrinsics by @yuyamashiro in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/615
* Add recursively composable LCU block encodings by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/611
* Codex/struct shor by @yuyamashiro in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/623
* Complete explicit Region SSA interfaces by @yuyamashiro in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/616
* docs: fix Möttönen tutorial cards in algorithm indexes by @jij-yuichiro-nakano in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/620
* docs: update multidimensional QFT tutorial title and citation by @jij-yuichiro-nakano in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/621
* Document algorithm and stdlib placement by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/626
* Add serializable QSVT circuit primitive by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/618
* docs: update PCE tutorial headings and index summary by @jij-yuichiro-nakano in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/622
* Add Qamomile v0.14.0 release notes by @ksk-jij in https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/pull/635


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jij-Inc/Qamomile/compare/v0.13.0...v0.14.0
